notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers four times.
Resolve the first Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
